name: False Teachers
overview: Scripture sternly condemns false testimony and deceit, emphasizing the importance of truthfulness among God's people. Commands such as not bearing false witness, raising false reports, or swearing falsely by God's name reveal the seriousness of dishonesty and its impact on community trust. These instructions highlight that false teachers, by spreading lies and profaning God's name, act in direct opposition to God's commands and harm the spiritual well-being of the church.
